Coaching Services

Teams & Organizations

Comprehensive performance support for teams and organizations, from assessment to seasonal programming.

Teams and Organizations coaching is designed to help groups of athletes improve their performance, develop stronger team dynamics, and build sustainable training programs that can evolve season to season. Whether you're running a club, managing a sports organization, or working with a coaching staff, we provide the expertise and support needed to elevate your entire program.

We work with coaches and organizations to assess needs, design comprehensive programming, and provide ongoing support that scales with your program's growth.

Pricing

$2,500-$10,000+ per season

Custom quotes available for larger programs and long-term partnerships.

What's Included in Teams & Organizations Coaching

Our team and organization coaching provides comprehensive support designed to serve the entire group while focusing on key athletes and program needs.

🔍 Team Assessment & Needs Evaluation

Begin with a thorough assessment of your team's current training status, coaching structure, and program goals. We'll identify strengths, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

📊 Full Seasonal/Year-Round Programming

Comprehensive periodized programming that evolves throughout the season. We'll design training cycles that align with competition schedules, recovery needs, and seasonal goals.

🧪 Testing Protocols

Implement standardized testing for strength, power, speed, endurance, and performance metrics. We'll design age-appropriate, safe testing protocols and help you interpret the data.

🎓 Coach Education & Staff Training

Educate your coaching staff on program principles, exercise selection, and progress monitoring. We'll conduct training sessions for your coaches to ensure consistent delivery and quality programming.

🏆 Support for 1-3 Key Athletes

While the program serves the entire team, we provide intensive, personalized support for your top performers. These athletes receive premium-level attention alongside the group program.

🏋️ Equipment Guidance

Recommendations for equipment and facilities needed for your program. We'll help you invest in the right tools to support training and competition.

📈 Data Tracking System Support

Help set up and use data tracking systems to monitor team progress. We'll work with you to organize data collection and create useful reports on team performance.
